summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an Argentine CNV 'Relevant Event' notice) disclosing that the company and its wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. repurchased treasury shares under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831. On the transaction date 30-Oct-2026, CPSA bought 120,000 book-entry ordinary shares (1 vote each, AR$1 par) on BYMA at an average price of AR$1,755.66, for a total of AR$210,679,528, settling 2-Nov-2026; no NYSE ADR purchases occurred. The repurchases stayed within the 25% average daily trading volume cap over the prior 90 business days. No board recommendation or advisor was cited. Watch for further buyback tranches and any overhang on the ADR facility.
